note: THE PLAN IS A DAG (ADR-0048 §228): nodes are work items, edges are prerequisites.
Status is a closed set: done | doing | todo | blocked. Exactly one node may be `doing`
(single focus is enforced by a criterion, so the plan cannot quietly grow two fronts).
'acceptance' must name something VISIBLE — a screen, a reading, or a file — never a count.
Placed under docs/decisions/ because §13's executable projection is the boundary the ADR test enforces: a plan file outside it is a red, not a preference.
